prompt:
Rewrite snippets/compliance-warning.liquid so that it renders product compliance warnings and includes each wrapper element only when it is needed. Inputs. All are top-level variables; nothing is under section.settings. Both are always supplied. - heading: string or null. - warnings: array or null. Each element is an object that always has these three keys: - code: string or null; - text: string or null; - url: string or null. Rules: 1. Valid warnings. A warning is valid when its text, after stripping leading and trailing whitespace, is non-empty. Invalid warnings produce no output at all. If there are no valid warnings, including when warnings is null or empty, output the empty string. 2. Outer wrapper. Otherwise output
...
. Inside it, in this order: a. If heading, stripped, is non-empty, output

HEADING

. Otherwise output no h2 element. b. If there is exactly one valid warning, output it as

ITEM

with no list. c. If there are two or more valid warnings, output
    containing one
  • ITEM
    • per valid warning, in input order, followed by
. 3. ITEM. Build each ITEM from two parts, in this order: a. Code prefix. If code, stripped, is non-empty, output CODE followed by exactly one space. CODE is the stripped code converted to upper case. b. Text. If url, stripped, is non-empty, output TEXT. Otherwise output TEXT alone. URL and TEXT are the stripped values. 4. Escaping. HTML-escape the heading, CODE (escape after upper-casing), URL and TEXT. 5. Whitespace. Output no whitespace or newlines between tags and no leading or trailing whitespace. The only whitespace outside of text values is the single space after . Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/compliance-warning.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
